facts.statement: Helicampodus lived during the Late Permian to Early Triassic periods.
The genus Helicampodus was described by Branson in 1935.
Fossils of Helicampodus have been found in Asia.
facts.quote: Fossils of Helicampodus have been found in Asia.

facts.statement: Helicampodus was formerly classified in the families Helicoprionidae and Edestidae but is now placed in Helicampodontidae.
facts.quote: It was earlier placed in the families Helicoprionidae and Edestidae, but has more recently been placed in Helicampodontidae.

facts.statement: Helicampodus belongs to the class Chondrichthyes.
The parent group of Helicampodus is the family Helicampodontidae.
